hooks.name: Verify on TS change
hooks.description: After a .ts/.tsx file is created or saved, run the same `npm run verify` (typecheck + lint + footgun scan) that the git pre-commit hook and CI run, so quality issues surface immediately while editing. This is a Kiro-only convenience layer; the universal enforcement is the committed githooks/pre-commit gate. Logic lives in package.json, not here, so the two never diverge.
